findings.summary: `LINE_BREAK_RE.match(data)` in `_parse_data(start=True)` is used without a None check, so an empty buffer raises AttributeError and a lone `\r` is taken as the whole line break, which makes the field data wrong when the body arrives in chunks.

findings.summary: When no boundary is found yet, `del_index = last_newline()` can be smaller than `data_start`, so the leading line break is never deleted and is emitted as part of the field's data after the state moves to DATA.

judge.reason: Describes last_newline() cut falling before data_start (at the leading CRLF) when no boundary is found, the same cause as b1.
